title: Citizens gather outside Prime Minister’s Office after Veliaj arrest
location: In front of the Prime Minister’s Office, Tirana
scope: Local gathering; distinctness from other February opposition actions needs review.
organizer: Supporters of Shqipëria Bëhet and Nisma Thurje; organizer not fully specified
participants_original: “Dozens of citizens and supporters”; no number given.
threshold_50_evidence: Does not establish 50 or more; the sole opened report describes turnout as “dozens” without a count.

start_date.summary: Article is dated 11 Feb. 2025 and says the protest took place Tuesday afternoon; 11 February 2025 was Tuesday.

location.summary: Outside the Prime Minister’s Office in Tirana.

demands.summary: The report says participants called for Prime Minister Edi Rama to resign and demanded accountability.

participants_original.summary: The article says “dozens”; no number or source estimate is supplied.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: “Dozens” does not establish the required numerical threshold.

protester_violence.summary: The report does not establish violence by demonstrators in this gathering.

state_response.summary: The article includes a separate social-media reaction by the prime minister concerning Veliaj; no response to the gathering itself is established.

notes: Candidate retained for review because occurrence, date, location, and a demand directed at the prime minister are reported, but the ≥50 attendance criterion is not established. The article reports a gathering the day after Veliaj’s arrest; temporal relation to other opposition demonstrations does not by itself establish episode identity. No event end is inferred.
open_questions: Could independent contemporary reporting establish turnout of at least 50?
Was this gathering organizationally or physically continuous with another February protest?
What was the event-specific state response and end time?
